defense_news.title: Anduril awarded contract to expand US Army’s next-gen battlefield command system
defense_news.summary: Anduril Industries received an Army contract worth up to $1.8 billion to continue expanding the service's Next Generation Command and Control.

defense_news.title: LaNeve to industry: ‘We are not walking away from modernization’
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Army's Futures and Concepts Command has been redesignated as U.S. Army Futures and Autonomous Systems, the service's top officer announced.

defense_news.title: BAE Systems unveils new layered air-defense system
defense_news.summary: The weapons include the long-awaited Multi-Domain Artillery Cannon System and a High-Power Microwave.

defense_news.title: How autonomous weapons are changing the way brigades fight
defense_news.summary: At Fort Bragg in August, Army soldiers tested how unmanned systems could help troops breach obstacles while reducing their exposure to battlefield hazards.
